claims.text: Sintel nurses an injured young dragon and names him Scales.
An adult dragon takes Scales. Sintel begins a long search.
After an attack in the mountains she takes her attacker’s spear and meets a shaman.
She reaches a cave with an adult dragon and a young one. The adult recognizes her scent and hesitates.
She fatally wounds the adult. Its scar reveals that she killed the grown Scales.
Her reflection reveals how much she aged during the search. She leaves; the young dragon follows her.
The 2010 Blender Institute film was directed by Colin Levy, written by Esther Wouda, produced by Ton Roosendaal, with music by Jan Morgenstern.
The official Blender Studio page identifies the adult dragon as Scales and licenses that character rig under CC-BY.
